final_text: {"status":"ANSWERED","claims":[{"text":"The standard covers passwords, API keys, tokens, certificates and other secrets used to access Harbourline systems.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"This standard covers passwords, API keys, tokens, certificates and other secrets used to access Harbourline systems."},{"text":"User passwords must be at least 14 characters long, must be stored only in the company-approved password manager, and must be combined with multi-factor authentication.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"User passwords must be at least 14 characters long, must be stored only in the company-approved password manager, and must be combined with multi-factor authentication."},{"text":"Passwords must never be shared.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"Passwords must never be shared."},{"text":"Service credentials are shared only by granting access through the secrets vault's access policies, never by sending the secret itself.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"Service credentials are shared only by granting access through the secrets vault's access policies, never by sending the secret itself."},{"text":"API keys and service credentials are rotated at least every 90 days, and immediately if exposure is suspected.","evidence_id":"E5","quote":"API keys and service credentials are rotated at least every 90 days, and immediately if exposure is suspected."},{"text":"If a secret is exposed, for example committed to a repository or pasted into a chat, it must be revoked or rotated immediately and reported as a security incident under the Incident Response Policy.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"If a secret is exposed, for example committed to a repository or pasted into a chat, it must be revoked or rotated immediately and reported as a security incident under the Incident Response Policy."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":[],"conflict_note":""}
